🚀 Cybertruck 2 Year Review: Is It Still Worth It in 2026?
 📷Two years after taking delivery, here’s my honest, no-filter look at living with the Tesla Cybertruck every single day. 

From real-world range and charging habits to durability after thousands of miles, daily driving quirks, software updates, and how the FSD experience has evolved — I’m covering it all.

In this video I share what surprised me the most, what still needs improvement, and whether the Cybertruck remains the ultimate futuristic truck or if the hype has cooled off after two full years of ownership.

If you’re thinking about buying a Cybertruck in 2026, or you already own one and want to hear real long-term thoughts, this review is for you.

What’s your biggest question about owning a Cybertruck after two years? Drop it in the comments below

Meet Emily Kate Genatowski.

She doesn't just study humanoid robots.
She lives with one.

For the past year, Emily has been cohabiting with 
a humanoid robot called Tova in Vienna researching 
what happens when AI moves into your home.
Legally. 
Ethically. 
And in everyday life.

Can a robot take public transport? Who is liable 
when it breaks something? Does it need a ticket 
for the bus?

These aren't hypothetical questions for Emily. 
They're her Tuesday.

And with Tesla building Optimus this couldn't 
be more relevant to our community right now.

He was thrown into physical comedy, prank challenges, and rapid Japanese banter he couldn’t understand. The result? Pure unfiltered joy and laughter.
